newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,018 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,018 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,018 contracts compared with 1,203 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 149 wheat, 311 corn, 357 soybean, 68 soymeal, 41 soyoil, three oat, 21 corn call, one soybean call and 67 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was unchanged to 1/4 cent per bushel higher, corn was 3/4 to 1-1/4 cents lower and soybeans were 3/4 to 1-1/2 cents lower.
